entities.summary: Dave Scott Feitl is a retired American professional basketball player who was selected by the Houston Rockets in the second round of the 1986 NBA draft. A 6'11" center from the University of Texas at El Paso, Feitl played in 5 National Basketball Association (NBA) seasons for four teams. He played for the Rockets, Golden State Warriors, Washington Bullets and New Jersey Nets.
